say:1:1035720001:1.text: Because it won't end well for you if you do go in.
say:1:1035720001:1.source_cn: 因为你真走进去了，也不会有什么好结果的。
say:1:1035720001:1.male: Because it won't end well for you if you do go in.
say:1:1035720001:1.female: Because it won't end well for you if you do go in.

say:2:1035720002:1.text: Our guys in there may not have much, but that doesn't make them pushovers.
say:2:1035720002:1.source_cn: 里面的弟兄们，要钱没什么钱，却一个个都不是好惹的。

say:3:1035720003:1.text: Especially the boss. He can fight for three days straight, but I doubt you'd last that long.
say:3:1035720003:1.source_cn: 特别是我们老大，如果你真的有点本事，他能拉着你打个三天三夜。
say:3:1035720003:1.male: Especially the boss. He can fight for three days straight, but I doubt you'd last that long.
say:3:1035720003:1.female: Especially the boss. He can fight for three days straight, but I doubt you'd last that long.

say:4:1035720004:1.text: I'm telling you, you'll wish you heeded my warning.
say:4:1035720004:1.source_cn: 到时候你就知道该听我的建议了。
say:4:1035720004:1.male: I'm telling you, you'll wish you heeded my warning.
say:4:1035720004:1.female: I'm telling you, you'll wish you heeded my warning.
